data.text:
# MNIST in ComfyResearch

**What you get:** image tensors shaped `[N,1,28,28]` and labels `0..9` (10 classes) from the **official MNIST IDX** archives (downloaded over HTTPS, cached under **download cache dir** or by default `~/.cache/comfy_research_mnist`).

**Offline blob toy:** use the **Gaussian blob dataset** node if you want class-specific 2D Gaussian templates with a tunable **noise level** and no download.

**Required wiring:**
- **MNIST dataset** `dataset` → Trainer **dataset** (one wire; train/test sizes live on the dataset node).
- Model must be **resnet_model** or **vit_model** (vision heads), not a flat **mlp_model** on raw spatial tensors (use **flatten to vector** on the dataset only with MLP + cross-entropy if you flatten).
- **cross_entropy_loss** → Trainer **loss** (required for ResNet/ViT).
- **adam_optimizer** (or SGD/Muon) → Trainer **optimizer**.

**Run:** open the Trainer node and press **Train**; loss curves appear in **Training Viz** when wired as in this template.

audit.title: Noise & smoothed trend
audit.procedure: Odd moving-average window W=5 on raw y; σ̂ = 1.4826×MAD(residual).
audit.confidenceLabel: reference row (not a sweep hit rate)

audit.title: Monotonicity (smoothed)
audit.procedure: Count signs of consecutive differences on ŷ (smoothed raw y).
audit.outcome: Smoothed curve is classified non-monotonic — dominant-direction share 90% is below the 95% monotone threshold.

complement.label: How far below the 95% monotone rule (higher ⇒ clearer non-monotone)

audit.title: Power-law fit (raw y vs steps)
audit.procedure: Fit on many step windows: full series, early/late spans (~12–60% of points), and first/second half when enough samples; among windows with R²≥0.9 pick highest noise×R² joint score (prefer narrower span on ties).
audit.outcome: **Law findings are disabled** until the smoothed curve is classified monotone (increasing or decreasing); scan metrics below are still computed. 10/20 fit windows reached R²≥0.9 (50% confidence-style hit rate). Full-series R²=0.595. Largest R² across scanned windows: 1.000 on “late (~12% of points)” (steps 89–100, 12 pts).
audit.confidenceLabel: fraction of fit windows with R²≥0.9

complement.label: Hypothetical joint on max-R² window (not emitted — monotone gate off)

audit.title: Exponential fit (raw y vs steps)
audit.procedure: Fit on many step windows: full series, early/late spans (~12–60% of points), and first/second half when enough samples; among windows with R²≥0.9 pick highest noise×R² joint score (prefer narrower span on ties).
audit.outcome: **Law findings are disabled** until the smoothed curve is classified monotone (increasing or decreasing); scan metrics below are still computed. 9/20 fit windows reached R²≥0.9 (45% confidence-style hit rate). Full-series R²=0.770. Largest R² across scanned windows: 1.000 on “late (~15% of points)” (steps 86–100, 15 pts).
audit.confidenceLabel: fraction of fit windows with R²≥0.9

complement.label: Hypothetical joint on max-R² window (not emitted — monotone gate off)

audit.title: Plateau test (smoothed)
audit.procedure: detectPlateauRegions on (step, ŷ); slope caps = {1,0.3,0.1,0.03,0.01}×baseline |dy/dx|; joint gate uses σ_eff = max(σ, f·A) with f ∈ {0.03,…,0.2} (best noise score) and strictness = strictest cap index with any overlap vs this lax span (not a prefix-only chain).
audit.outcome: Structural hit rate: 5/5 slope-cap levels returned ≥1 plateau-shaped region (100%). Best joint noise×strictness among gated candidates: 100%.
audit.confidenceLabel: fraction of detector levels with ≥1 structural hit

audit.title: Phase-transition test (smoothed)
audit.procedure: detectPhaseTransitionRegions with sharpness deltas {1.5,3,6,12,24} on ŷ; joint gate matches plateau/spike (σ_eff sweep; strictness = best overlapping δ index).
audit.outcome: Structural hit rate: 5/5 δ settings returned ≥1 phase-like region (100%). Best joint noise×strictness among gated candidates: 100%.
audit.confidenceLabel: fraction of δ levels with ≥1 structural hit

audit.title: Spike test (smoothed)
audit.procedure: detectSpikeRegions with the same δ ladder as phase transitions; joint gate matches plateau (σ_eff sweep; strictness = best overlapping δ index).
audit.outcome: Structural hit rate: 4/5 δ settings returned ≥1 spike-like region (80%). Best joint noise×strictness among gated candidates: 51%.
audit.confidenceLabel: fraction of δ levels with ≥1 structural hit

audit.title: U-shape / inverted-U / double descent & ascent
audit.procedure: Multi-scale moving averages on raw y; persistence across windows; noise-gated depths.
audit.outcome: Strongest higher-order shape candidate joint score 33%.
audit.confidenceLabel: presence (1 if any shape cleared joint gate)
